Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing the department of ecology's ability to aid the development of air quality projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring the department of ecology to aid inthe development of projects designed to demonstrate to the publicoptions available for preserving the state's natural resources throughenhanced air quality; adding a new section to chapter 70.94 RCW; andmaking an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.94 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that degraded air quality can have asubstantial negative effect on the value and productivity of thestate's natural resources, including the public's enjoyment of theoutdoor recreation available in Washington. As such, the legislaturefinds that the department of ecology, as the lead state clean airregulatory body, should aid in the development of demonstrationprojects that raise awareness about options available to enhance thestate's air quality. (2) The department shall provide technical advice and funding for,at a minimum, a demonstration project developed with a science museumthat has an existing program designed to bring science education to p. 1 HB 1301children by way of a mobile learning vehicle. The demonstrationproject must enhance the existing program in a way that will providetraveling exhibits to help students learn about the connection betweenenergy generation and clean air, the impact different sources of energyhave on clean air and the environment, the scientific properties ofenergy, and the different uses of energy.

The sum of four hundred forty-nine thousandnine hundred sixty-three dollars, or as much thereof as may benecessary, is appropriated for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2008,from the general fund to the department of ecology for the purposes ofthis act.
